text:
The Miyajima torii doesn't always float.
Below about 100 cm of tide, you can walk up to it.
Above about 250 cm, it seems to rise out of the sea.
Some days you get both 👇

👉 How to get the day you want:
https://japanbystation.com/hiroshima-miyajima-one-day

🌅 Start at 7:30 in Hiroshima
The Peace Memorial Museum opens at 7:30
if you book the early slot online.
See the Peace Park and A-Bomb Dome
before the tour groups.

🚆 Then the fast way to the island
JR to Miyajimaguchi in about 25–30 minutes.
Then a 10-minute ferry for ¥200.
The JR Pass covers it all.
The tram is ¥240, but takes about 70–75 minutes.

🌊 Let the tide plan your afternoon
The Tourist Association's tide table shows
when it's below 100 cm or above 250 cm.
Pick a day with both in daylight.

👉 The ferries that pass right by the torii:
https://japanbystation.com/hiroshima-miyajima-one-day
